scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems about derivatives of an atomistic or cell energy, with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: The potential V is a function of the displacements of a finite set of sites (a supercell with every image explicit, or a cluster), each with three Cartesian coordinates; Phi2 and Phi3 are its exact second and third partial derivatives at the reference configuration u.

The catalog's lattice-vector labels R, R' become explicit site labels of the finite set. For an infinite crystal with finite-range force constants the lattice sum rule sum_{j,R} Phi_ij(R) = 0 is the statement for a supercell large enough that no interaction wraps onto itself.

The acoustic sum rules follow from invariance of V under rigid translations for a potential twice continuously differentiable at u (Phi2) or three times (Phi3); the permutation symmetry of Phi3 needs V three times continuously differentiable at u. Rotational (Born-Huang) sum rules are not covered.
